# The clang compilers defined below are the same as what's defined in
# mozilla-central for Firefox builds, except that the Android compiler-rt
# pieces have been left out.

linux64-clang-22:
    description: "Clang 22 toolchain build"
    attributes:
        local-toolchain: true
    treeherder:
        symbol: TL(clang-22)
    worker:
        max-run-time: 600
    run:
        script: repack-clang.sh
        toolchain-alias:
            by-project:
                toolchains: null
                default: linux64-clang
        toolchain-artifact: public/build/clang.tar.zst
    fetches:
        toolchain:
            - linux64-cctools-port
            - linux64-clang-22-raw
            - linux64-aarch64-compiler-rt-22
            - linux64-x64-compiler-rt-22
            - macosx64-aarch64-compiler-rt-22
            - macosx64-x64-compiler-rt-22
            - wasm32-wasi-compiler-rt-22
            - win32-compiler-rt-22
            - win64-aarch64-compiler-rt-22
            - win64-compiler-rt-22

win64-clang-22:
    description: "Clang-cl 22 toolchain build"
    attributes:
        local-toolchain: true
    treeherder:
        symbol: TW64(clang-22)
    worker:
        max-run-time: 600
    run:
        script: repack-clang.sh
        toolchain-alias:
            by-project:
                toolchains: null
                default:
                    - win64-clang
                    - win64-clang-toolchain
        toolchain-artifact: public/build/clang.tar.zst
    fetches:
        toolchain:
            - linux64-cctools-port
            - win64-clang-22-raw
            - linux64-aarch64-compiler-rt-22
            - linux64-x64-compiler-rt-22
            - macosx64-aarch64-compiler-rt-22
            - macosx64-x64-compiler-rt-22
            - wasm32-wasi-compiler-rt-22
            - win32-compiler-rt-22
            - win64-aarch64-compiler-rt-22
            - win64-compiler-rt-22
